title: City manager or designee
text:
19.31.060 City manager or designee.
Initial decision-maker. The city manager or his designee is the initial decision-maker for the following:
A.	Appeal of a decision on any application for which a staff member is the responsible official;
B.	Alternative subdivision designs, exception or waiver petition for any application for which the a staff member is the responsible official;
C.	Vested rights petition for any decision where a staff member is the responsible official for the application for which the vested rights petition is submitted; and
D.	Petition for relief from a dedication or construction requirement in accordance with chapter 19.46 and other provisions of this title.
(Ord. No. 17236, §§ 7, 16, 11-10-2009; Ord. No. 17396, § 25, 8-24-2010)
